name: clip-studio
description: Script-to-clips desktop tool for audio/localisation teams.

scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && mv dist-electron/preload.js dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "node scripts/dev-renderer.mjs" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
